paragraphs.text: Muri is a caracal , the cat familiar of Jinnie Fay , who is affiliated with the Cabaretti crime family in New Capenna . She appears in the story alongside Jinnie, who often strokes and interacts with Muri, showcasing their close bond. Muri gives a quiet presence of comfort and companionship amidst the political and social machinations of the Cabaretti.

In Jetmir 's office at the Vantoleone, Muri was seen enjoying the attention from Jinnie Fay , who stroked her as they discussed the upcoming Crescendo , an important Cabaretti event. Jinnie's dog Regis was also there. As Jinnie planned the festivities and engaged in strategic conversations with Jetmir, Muri offered a moment of calm and distraction. After the discussion, Muri hopped into Jinnie's purse, showing her role as a close and trusted companion a giving a sense of normalcy and domesticity amidst the backdrop of the Cabaretti's plans for dominance in New Capenna. Muri's presence illustrates the softer, more personal side of these influential characters.
